ValidationRule.description: The Event Data section should not be populated if the "Associated to an MRB Event?" is = No
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( !$Setup.Bypass_Automation_Setting__c.Interaction_Validation__c, ISPICKVAL( Associated_to_an_MRB_Event__c, "No"), OR( NOT(ISBLANK(Event_Name__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Event_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Event_PoC__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(City__c))) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Event Data section should not be populated if the "Associated to an MRB Event?" is = No
